empty.title: No meetings yet
empty.body: Your meeting notes will appear here.

profile.title: About you
profile.description: Helps Scribewell write notes that fit your role. Stays on this device and is only sent to the AI provider you choose.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Scribewell records your microphone as "Me" and your computer's sound as "Them". No bot joins your calls.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Run models on this computer with Ollama, or use your own API key with a cloud provider.

data.title: Data and privacy
data.privacy: Everything is stored on this device. Scribewell has no accounts and sends no usage data. The only network requests go to services you set up.

profile.name: Your name
profile.aboutHint: For example the kind of meetings you have, or how you like notes written.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: I run customer interviews and want notes focused on problems and quotes.

mic.allZero: The microphone delivered pure silence. Check that it isn't muted and that Scribewell is allowed to use it.
mic.silent: Didn't hear anything. Try speaking louder or choose another microphone.

system.captured: Captured the test sound from {{device}}. Other people on your calls will be transcribed.
system.notCaptured: Couldn't capture the test sound from {{device}}. Check that it isn't muted, or pick the output you use for calls.

devices.outputHint: Everything this device plays is captured as "Them".

provider.legend: Model for writing notes and answering questions

ollama.label: Ollama (on this computer)

openai.description: GPT models with your own API key.

ollama.notRunningHint: Install it from ollama.com and start it, then check again. Looking at {{url}}.
ollama.noModels: No models installed yet. Run "ollama pull qwen3:8b" in a terminal, then check again.

keys.explainer: Keys are stored in your system keychain and only sent to that provider. Scribewell never shows a saved key again.
keys.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace it

openaiApiKey.label: OpenAI
openaiApiKey.description: For notes and chat, and optional cloud transcription.

welcome.title: Meeting notes that stay yours
welcome.body: Jot down what matters during a call. Scribewell transcribes the conversation on your computer and turns your rough notes into clear, structured notes when the meeting ends.

privacy.title: How Scribewell handles your data
privacy.localBody: Audio, transcripts and notes live in a local database. Nothing is uploaded unless you set it up.
privacy.noAccountBody: There's nothing to sign up for, and Scribewell sends no usage data.
privacy.aiBody: Use models on this computer, or your own API key with a provider you trust.
privacy.consentBody: Tell the people you meet with that you're taking notes with transcription. Recording laws differ by place.

microphone.title: Check your microphone
microphone.body: Your side of the conversation is recorded from your microphone.
microphone.deniedSystemWide: Microphone access is turned off for this device. Turn it on, then check again.
microphone.deniedDesktopApps: Microphone access is on, but desktop apps aren't allowed to use it. Turn on "Let desktop apps access your microphone", then check again.

systemAudio.title: Check your computer's sound
systemAudio.body: Other people on a call are recorded from what your computer plays, so no bot needs to join. We'll play a short tone to test this.
systemAudio.headphones: Headphones work best. With speakers, your microphone also picks up the other side of the call.

ai.title: Choose an AI model
ai.body: Scribewell uses it to write your notes and answer questions. You can change this any time.

profile.title: Tell Scribewell about you
profile.body: Optional. This helps notes match your role and the meetings you have.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: You can change any of these choices later in Settings.
